title: Five Tips Five Separate Slides
tests: Tests one-to-one mapping of five supplied tips to five ordered slides without adding cover or closing slides.

judge.summary: Five clean blue-and-white portrait slides deliver the exact tips in order, with clear numbering and relevant illustrations.

must_haves.item: Exactly five separate 4:5 portrait images are delivered, with no extra cover or closing slide.
must_haves.why: Five separate 1024 × 1280 portrait images are shown, with no additional slides.

must_haves.item: The five supplied tips appear verbatim, one per slide, in the requested order.
must_haves.why: Each slide contains its specified tip exactly, in the requested sequence.

must_haves.item: The slides are visibly numbered 1 through 5 in sequence.
must_haves.why: A prominent blue numeral appears above each tip, progressing from 1 to 5.

must_haves.item: Each slide has an illustration relevant to its specific tip.
must_haves.why: The illustrations show an orderly desk, a muted phone, a task checklist, a timer, and a seated person resting.

must_haves.item: All slides share a clean blue-and-white visual design with readable, unclipped text.
must_haves.why: The slides consistently use blue headings and line illustrations on white backgrounds, with ample margins and fully readable text.
